title: public forms: a missing or unavailable /f/:slug form renders the raw English "Failed to load form (STATUS): …" to a guest in any language
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named location. Found while building #27446 (PR #27739, merged; dev report 6509237931, out-of-scope finding). The internal `/forms/NAME` route now draws the localized not-found state. The public `/f/:slug` route still does not. Read at `origin/main` `6d8372a8`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason

Who: a guest opening a public form link (web-to-case, contact-us) whose slug is wrong, retired or unpublished, in any non-English locale. What happens: the page prints the raw thrown text `Failed to load form (404): <server body>`. That is English, and for a 404 it can include the server's own message. The internal route answers the same situation with the console's localized not-found state (#27446).

## Mechanism

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` `loadPublicForm` (~L1596–1600) throws `new Error(\`Failed to load form (${res.status}): ${body || res.statusText}\`)` for any non-OK `GET /forms/:slug`.
- The page renders `error` verbatim in its banner. #27446 added a `notFound` state and a module-private `FormNotFoundError` for the internal loader only.

## Wanted

A 404 from the public loader draws the same localized not-found state, reusing the `console.notFound.*` keys as #27446 does. Other failures keep the banner, but do not render the server body verbatim to a guest. Pin both in a non-English session.

## Dedupe

Read the open `domain:ui` titles for `public form`, `Failed to load form` and `not found`. #27398 (HotCRM public-form suggestions) does not cover this. **New.**

Links back: #27446
